reference.question: \(AB\) is a diameter of \(\odot O\), and point \(C\) lies on the circle (distinct from \(A\) and \(B\)). Given \(\angle A=35^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle B\) in degrees.
reference.solution:
Method 1: Diameter and complementary acute angles

\(\angle ACB=90^\circ\), so \(\angle B=90^\circ-35^\circ=55^\circ\).
